cards.mood: The piece opens with a tense, atmospheric buildup that quickly erupts into an aggressive and defiant energy.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted electric guitars playing palm-muted chugging riffs and open power chords form the harmonic backbone, present throughout the track except for the atmospheric intro.
